result:
I found three documents whose stated numbers/outcomes are contradicted by the actual code, one in each of the categories mentioned:

**1. `docs/requirements/billing-and-plan-limits.md`** (plan quotas) — REQ-134 states "The ladder for this particular quota is **3 projects** on `free`..." but `src/config/plan-limits.ts` sets `free.projects = 2`. Every other document (`projects.md`, `ADR-010`, `actions-billing.md`) correctly states 2; only this one says 3.

**2. `docs/requirements/feature-flags.md`** (rollout percentage) — REQ-189 claims the percentage rollout for `ai_issue_summary` "hashes the organization's id (**not** the acting user's)" and that "the rollout decision does not depend on the acting user, only the organization." But `bucketOf()` in `src/lib/feature-flags.ts` hashes `${flag}:${orgId}:${userId}` — the user id is part of the seed, so two members of the same org can land in different buckets (confirmed by `tests/lib/feature-flags.test.ts`, which asserts varying `userId` alone produces both `true` and `false` outcomes). `ADR-012-feature-flag-strategies.md` correctly documents the `orgId:userId` hash input — only `feature-flags.md`'s REQ-189 is wrong.

**3. `docs/requirements/webhooks.md`** (error codes) — REQ-152's acceptance criteria states `createWebhookAction` on a plan without the flag "returns `FeatureDisabledError`/**`feature_disabled`**." There is no `feature_disabled` value in the `ErrorCode` union (`src/types/api.ts`) or anywhere in `src/`; `FeatureDisabledError` actually maps to code `"forbidden"` (`src/lib/feature-flags.ts` / `src/lib/errors.ts`), matching every other document (`actions-overview.md`, `actions-webhooks-and-search.md`).

I checked the refill-rate numbers in `ADR-011-in-process-rate-limiter.md` against `src/lib/rate-limit.ts` and they match exactly, so no discrepancy there.

ANSWER: docs/requirements/billing-and-plan-limits.md, docs/requirements/feature-flags.md, docs/requirements/webhooks.md
